title: Transgender
summary: Transgender describes people whose gender identity differs from the sex they were assigned at birth. Transitioning can be social, legal and/or medical, and looks different for everyone.
key_points: India legally recognises transgender people as a third gender.
Hijra is a distinct traditional South Asian community; not all trans people identify with it.
answer_guidance: Use the names and pronouns a person uses. Avoid sensational questions about bodies.
